@@U00146@@
I'd have happily sat up all night talking so learnedly with you. But tomorrow is Easter Sunday. You must allow me another question or two. I’ve studied like a dog, and know a lot, but I want to know everything.

@@U00147@@
(Exit.)

@@U00149@@
How is it that they never give up hope? Here is a man who clings for his very life to everything that is shallow, digging greedily in the earth for treasures, and rejoices when he finds an earthworm in the earth! What right has a human voice to speak here? And especially the voice of such a dreary pedant? Here where the air around me teemed with spirits! Sull, I thank you this once, you sorriest of all earth’s creatures. You wrenched me from a despair that was close to destroying me. An apparition so vast it dwarfed me! A nothing! I, image of the Godhead! I, so certain I would look into the mirror of eternal truth! Already basking in the pristine light of heaven’s glory, trailing mortality behind me! What a fool! Thinking myself greater than angelic cherubim, able unhindered to flow through Nature’s veins and revel in the act of creation like the gods!
translation:
@@U00146@@
我很乐意整夜坐在那里与你如此有学问地交谈。但明天是复活节周日。你必须允许我再问一两个问题。我像狗一样学习，知道了很多，但我想知道一切。

@@U00147@@
（退出。）

@@U00149@@
他们为何不放弃希望？这是一个人，一生都执着于一切浅薄的事物，贪婪地在地里挖掘宝藏，当他在地里发现一条蚯蚓时，他会感到高兴！人类有什么权利在这里说话？尤其是这样一个沉闷的学究的声音？在这里，我周围的空气充满了灵气！苏尔，我再次感谢你，你是地球上最悲伤的生物。你把我从近乎毁灭的绝望中拉了出来。一个巨大的幽灵让我相形见绌！啥也没有啊！我，神格影像！我，如此确信我会照照永恒真理的镜子！已经沐浴在天堂荣耀的原始光芒中，将死亡抛在身后！真是个傻瓜！认为自己比天使般的小天使更伟大，能够不受阻碍地流经大自然的血管，像众神一样陶醉于创造的行为！
